Look at the rot eating away at our traditional institutions. During a graduation ceremony in Jaipur, right in front of the Deputy Chief Minister, a student used a solemn milestone meant to honor achievement to launch a public protest about administrative issues. 

This entitlement and blatant lack of proper discipline is a glaring symptom of the total collapse of respect and decorum. Instead of upholding dignity, she chose to air grievances and grandstand. The progressive crowd might cheer for this kind of disruptive behavior, but it is nothing more than selfishness. When the young lose respect for authority and the proper channels of order, chaos is the inevitable result. Thankfully, the university administration is staying silent and refusing to reward this display. It is past time we restore basic standards of decorum and personal responsibility in our schools.
